title: The Whispering Catacombs
goal: Descend into the catacombs and escape with the Saint's Relic — or at least escape with your life.
prologue: Plague has hollowed out the city above, and the priests swear the only cure lies with the Saint's Relic — sealed in the catacombs generations ago, when the dead first began to whisper. Everyone who has gone down for it has stayed down. You took the church's coin anyway: a lantern, a borrowed nerve, and a map that ends at a rusted gate. Tonight the whispering is louder than usual.

lantern.name: Oil Lantern
lantern.description: Steady flame and a reserve of oil. Use it from your pack to bind wounds and rest (+8 HP).

charm.name: Bone Charm
charm.description: An old ward against the dark — +3 to Agility checks among the bones.

iron_key.name: Iron Key
iron_key.description: Heavy, cold, and older than the city above. Opens the inner sanctum.

crypt_gate.description: A toothed iron gate yawns at the bottom of the chapel stairs. Cold air breathes out of the dark, carrying a faint, dry whispering. Worn steps lead down; to one side, a rusted grille hides a narrower shortcut.

choices.text: Descend the worn stairs into the hall
Force the rusted grille for a shortcut

condition.success_text: The grille shrieks, bends and gives; you squeeze through into the cold air of the reliquary.
condition.fail_text: The grille tears loose all at once and you pitch through after it, wrenching your shoulder on the iron.

hall.description: A long processional hall, its frescoes bleached to ghosts. A dead sconce still cradles an oil lantern, somehow unspent. Two ways onward: an arch of stacked skulls to the east, and a dripping passage sloping down to the west.

choices.text: Enter the ossuary beneath the skull arch
Follow the dripping passage down to the cistern

ossuary.description: Ten thousand skulls watch from the walls. As you step in, the bones at the far end knit themselves upright into a towering figure of fused vertebrae — a Bone Sentinel, woken to guard the way deeper.

monster.name: Bone Sentinel
monster.success_text: Your shoulder crashes into its spine and the Sentinel bursts apart into a rain of loose bones.
monster.fail_text: A bony fist slams into your ribs before the Sentinel topples — you stagger past it, every breath a stab.

choices.text: Slip back to the hall and leave it be
Topple a roof pillar onto it and slip past

condition.success_text: You kick the cracked pillar out and dart beneath the falling stone; it buries the Sentinel and you slip through.
condition.fail_text: The pillar comes down faster than you planned — a chunk of masonry clips your back as you dive clear into the reliquary.

reliquary.description: A vaulted chamber of niches and tarnished offerings. A bone charm hangs from a hook by the door — a pilgrim's ward. At the center, a cracked sarcophagus; beyond it, a sealed sanctum door set with an empty keyhole.

choices.text: Search the sarcophagus for the sanctum key

condition.success_text: Your fingers find the key wedged between the saint's ribs and slide it free without a sound.
condition.fail_text: The lid shifts and pins your fingers against the stone — you wrench the key free, knuckles skinned and throbbing.

choices.text: Leave the bones and head down to the cistern

sanctum_door.description: The sanctum door is iron-banded oak, swollen with centuries of damp. The keyhole is a cold black slot. Without the right key it will not yield — and the whispering is loudest here.

choices.text: Abandon the door and retreat to the cistern

inner_sanctum.description: Within rests the Saint's Relic on a bier of salt — a reliquary of gold and glass, untouched by the rot of the place. Lifting it, the whispering finally stills. A narrow flue above promises open sky.

choices.text: Take the relic and climb the narrow flue to the surface

condition.success_text: Braced back and feet against the flue, you inch upward until grey light spills over your face.
condition.fail_text: Halfway up your legs start to shake; you slip, scrape your back raw on the stone, and grind on to the top.

cistern.description: A drowned chamber. Black water fills it to the knees, then the chest, then who knows. A slick stone ledge skirts one wall; somewhere below, a dull glint of gold winks under the surface.

choices.text: Wade straight across the black water

condition.success_text: Chest-deep and shivering, you force your way across and haul yourself onto the far steps.
condition.fail_text: The floor drops away and the undertow rolls you through black water — you come up against the far steps choking, half-drowned.

condition.success_text: Palms flat to the stone, you inch along the ledge and step down safely on the far side.
condition.fail_text: Your boot skids off the slick stone and you slam a knee into the ledge before you catch yourself and limp on.

choices.text: Dive into the flooded side-shaft after the gold

condition.success_text: You kick down through the black water and surface in a hidden vault, gold glinting in the silt.
condition.fail_text: The cold steals your breath halfway down; you surface in the vault coughing water, ears ringing.

sealed_well.description: An old well shaft, dry now, its stones furred with pale moss. Far above, a coin of grey daylight. Iron rungs climb the wall — half of them rusted to nubs.

choices.text: Climb the rungs to the surface

condition.success_text: Rung by rung you climb toward the coin of daylight above.
condition.fail_text: A rusted rung snaps under your weight; you slide back, palms torn, then find a hold and climb on.

relic_ending.description: You haul yourself out into a grey dawn, the Saint's Relic cold against your chest. The whispering is gone. Whatever was bound in the catacombs is bound still — and the relic in your hands is worth a kingdom, or a cure, or simply a way home. You walk into the light.

escape_ending.description: You drag yourself over the well's lip and lie gasping under open sky. No relic, no glory — but the catacombs kept their dead and let you keep your life. Some days, down here, that is the whole of victory.

sunken_vault.description: Your fingers close on the gold — a fat handful of old coin — as the silt-choked passage behind you folds shut. For a moment there is only black water and the glint in your fist. Then you see it: a crack in the vault wall, and above it a faint grey sliver of daylight.

choices.text: Squeeze up through the crack toward the daylight
